description: Call BEFORE writing or editing a file. Reports new @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, @ts-nocheck, as any, : any, # type: ignore, # pyright: ignore, @phpstan-ignore, #[allow(dead_code)] or //nolint in the proposed text. If blocked, fix the type instead of writing the suppression.

new_text.description: The new file content, or the replacement text for an edit.

old_text.description: The text being replaced, so existing suppressions are not flagged.

path.description: File that will be written (its extension picks the language).

name: check_suppressions
title: Check for type-checker escape hatches
